comment: One entry per pasted block: `doc` + exact `fence` info string + `source` + the `begin`/`end` marker lines in that source. `python3 tools/check-invariants.py` enforces one-to-one: a block with no entry, an entry with no block, a duplicate (doc, fence), and a doc outside the owning check's `patterns` all fail. Comparison ignores trailing whitespace and blank edges, nothing else.
